mentions.name: Trilogy Studio Core
mentions.description: Dashboard feature work in Trilogy Studio Core, a data studio for building interactive dashboards. The author is experimenting with dashboard features using the GCAT space dataset, demonstrated by a launch-stats example dashboard that runs on DuckDB with a GCAT space data model.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been exploring the amazing GCAT space dataset - it’s been a good way to drive some dashboard feature experimentation using fun data. Still need to work on my dashboard design skills, though.
